correctness.rationale: The source trace representation is reconstructed using a primitive element of \(\mathbb F_{25}\) and the exact exponents \(20\) and \(13\). The resulting rank-four code reproduces the published original enumerator exactly. Puncturing coordinate zero reproduces the published \([23,4,15]_5\) enumerator, and the kernel of the deleted coordinate gives a rank-three shortened generator reproducing the published \([23,3,16]_5\) enumerator. All \(1119\) positive-dimensional subspaces of \(\mathbb F_5^4\) and all \(63\) of \(\mathbb F_5^3\) are generated exactly once in RREF, and basis-support unions exactly equal subcode supports. The complete histograms therefore exhaust all subcodes.

value.rationale: The 2026 source introduces puncturing and shortening as one of its three principal code classes and highlights the q=5 pair with explicit good dual parameters. A complete SSWD is the natural higher-dimensional refinement of the few-weight data emphasized by the paper: it resolves every support-incidence layer, gives both weight hierarchies, and counts all extremal subcodes. Treating the punctured and shortened companions together also shows how the two standard derivations from the same cyclic parent differ beyond their ordinary enumerators, providing a compact structural fingerprint rather than an arbitrary isolated statistic.
